description:
## Goal

Replace whole-root backend assembly scans with exact shared contributions so root packaging work is proportional to changed executable, wrapper, atom, and reachable-schema membership.

## Current defect

Root production clones every backend executable, repeatedly reallocates and linearly deduplicates callable owners, globally sorts/densifies functions, rescans atoms, and snapshots all settled struct schemas. The last main-root request to settlement bracket on 00420 is about 262 ms; this is a bracket, not isolated attribution. Whole-world schema snapshotting is not an exact product read and can include unrelated settled state.

## Strategy

1. After transport population pruning, expose immutable keyed executable/wrapper contributions and exact reachable schema obligations.
2. Maintain deterministic root membership/order from stable semantic identities rather than rebuilding/densifying the entire program after every movement.
3. Incrementally update atom/schema inventories from exact product dependencies.
4. Preserve canonical symbol/function order and byte-identical artifacts.
5. Delete `union_boxed` linear dedup, global executable clone assembly, whole-world struct snapshot, repeated atom walk, and temporary counters once the keyed model owns all consumers.

## Signal

- Unchanged request performs no packaging.
- Unreachable edit changes no root contribution.
- Reached leaf edit evaluates only exact root-reader contributions.
- Adding/removing one reachable executable or schema changes only the corresponding membership and deterministic link projection.
- Same backend/native artifacts and runtime results.
- Full library, fixture matrix, cross-process determinism, formatting, and strict clippy pass.
title: Make root backend packaging react to exact keyed contributions
